speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether the Government will consider introducing mandatory caregiving leave for private sector companies.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The tripartite partners will continue to encourage and equip employers to provide flexible work arrangements to support employees in managing both their work and caregiving responsibilities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The Government will also continue to review and strengthen other support for working caregivers.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This includes enhancing the caregiving support infrastructure, financial support and fostering a more family-friendly culture.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: Just a short supplementary question, please, Mr Leon Perera.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: I am wondering if the Government will consider requiring or mandating private companies to provide an elderly or parent care leave to some extent, or flexible work arrangements that will allow for time for eldercare and parent care duties?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: There is a lot of feedback from constituents, from people and as our population ages, it is going to get worse.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: As explained earlier, flexible work arrangements are also a very useful way to help working caregivers to manage both work and caregiving needs.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Order of the day and Notices of Motion.
